text: A year after her twin Dani was murdered in a newly bought country house, the blind clairvoyant Darcy, who keeps a cabinet of curiosities in Cork, reads the glass eye of the man blamed for it. Soon she arrives at the house where Dani's widower Ted lives with his new girlfriend Yana, having sent ahead [a life-sized wooden golem in a chest|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. Through the night it shifts position, its head stuffed with photographs, hair and blood, as Darcy comes to [accuse Ted of hiring the killer|threat|people in your own life] and [seek a reckoning|wants|revenge for a wrong].
